annotators.description: An AI assistant (GitHub Copilot) that wrote the Wave 1 evaluation cases and their labels after the engine and its knowledge pack existed. Not a human. The labels are migrated without change; Wave 1 recorded no uncertainty per label.

An AI assistant (GitHub Copilot, Wave 2 agent A) that wrote the dev and validation cases and labelled them from the scenario it invented, using only the vocabulary and never the engine or the detectors. Not a human.
An AI assistant (GitHub Copilot, Wave 2) that writes the locked test split and its labels without seeing the dev or validation cases, the engine or the detectors. Not a human.
